title: List Flow projects
description: List and filter projects on flow.google.com via verified local API or browser UI before selecting a target project.

inputs.limit: Max projects to fetch (default 21 in observed RPC).

api: Run `node .agents/skills/flow-project/references/api-client.mjs list-projects [--limit 21]` or call `listProjects()` from `api-client.mjs`.
Underlying RPC: POST `/_/AiSandboxAngularFrontend/data/batchexecute?rpcids=UpteDb` (inherits shared batchexecute query/form parameterGroup in `api.json`).

Args payload in `f.req` (`envelope[0][0][1]`): `["projects/*", 21, null, null, null, null, [1]]`. Decoded `wrb.fr` frame returns array `data[0]` where each item has `item[0]` (project UUID) and `item[1][0]` (project title).
If local cookies or `at` token are expired (`AUTH_REQUIRED`), attach browser via `flow:auth` to refresh.
browser: Navigate to `https://flow.google.com/` and call `studio_inspect`; if redirected to Google login, run `flow:auth`.
Extract project cards/links (`a[href^="/project/"]`) using `studio_extract` to read titles and project UUIDs. Do not click the create button when only listing.
Scroll incrementally if additional projects need to load.
success: Returns project IDs, titles, and `/project/<id>` URLs without leaking cookies or tokens.
Distinguishes an empty project list from expired auth or unloaded UI.
verification: Verified standalone API execution (`UpteDb`) and browser UI extraction on 2026-11-06.

execution.evidence: 2026-11-06: standalone UpteDb call via api-client.mjs returned decoded project list including known test project without CAPTCHA challenge.

title: Create a Flow project
description: Create a new project on flow.google.com via verified API (`jHPbke`) or browser UI, with support for follow-up renaming (`o8DA4`).

inputs.name: Desired project title (mapped to `args[1][1][0]` in `jHPbke`, or applied via `flow:rename-project` after UI creation).

api: Run `node .agents/skills/flow-project/references/api-client.mjs create-project --name "<title>"` or import `createProject({ name })` from `api-client.mjs`.
Underlying RPC: POST `/_/AiSandboxAngularFrontend/data/batchexecute?rpcids=jHPbke` using local cookies and `at` token.
Args payload in `f.req` (`envelope[0][0][1]`): `["projects/*", [null, [name]], [null, 22]]`. Decoded `wrb.fr` response returns new `projectId` at `data[0]` and title at `data[1][0]`.

Reusable composition: after creating a project (or if UI creation assigns a default timestamp title), call `renameProject({ projectId, name })` (`RPC o8DA4`) to set or update the title without recreating the project.
Confirm creation via `flow:list-projects` if network response is interrupted; never retry blind writes.
browser: On `https://flow.google.com/`, inspect and click the new project button (`button[aria-label='addDự án mới']` or localized equivalent) once.
Wait and re-inspect until URL transitions to `/project/<id>`.
If UI creates a default timestamp name and a custom `name` was requested, either call `flow:api-rename-project` with the new `<id>` or edit `flow-editable-text input` in the header and press `Enter`.
success: Returns the new `projectId` and `/project/<id>` URL confirmed by API response or list check.
verification: Verified standalone API (`jHPbke`), follow-up rename (`o8DA4`), and browser creation flow.

execution.evidence: Authenticated jHPbke RPC creates project with custom title and returns UUID; verified with UpteDb list and o8DA4 rename.

title: Rename an existing Flow project
description: Reusable task to rename any Flow project by ID via verified API (`o8DA4`) or the project header editable input.
api: Run `node .agents/skills/flow-project/references/api-client.mjs rename-project --id <projectId> --name "<newTitle>"` or import `renameProject({ projectId, name })` from `api-client.mjs`.
Underlying RPC: POST `/_/AiSandboxAngularFrontend/data/batchexecute?rpcids=o8DA4` with `source-path=/project/<projectId>`.
Args payload in `f.req` (`envelope[0][0][1]`): `["projects/<projectId>", [name], [["project_title"]], [null, 22]]`.
Decoded `wrb.fr` response returns `[name]`, confirming the updated title immediately.
browser: Inside `/project/<projectId>`, inspect header for `flow-editable-text input`.
Click the input, fill with `name`, and press `Enter` (`studio_press` with `key: 'Enter'`).
Re-inspect header title to confirm the new name is committed.
success: API `wrb.fr` payload returns `[name]` or UI header reflects the updated title.
verification: Captured from live UI interaction and verified standalone via `api-client.mjs` on 2026-11-06.

execution.evidence: 2026-11-06: captured RPC o8DA4 during live header rename and verified standalone execution via api-client.mjs.

title: Open and inspect a Flow project
description: Load a Flow project's metadata, scene/asset state, and model catalog via API (`ngNC2`, `Zzl0ze`, `HTrJv`) or open the project workspace in browser UI.
api: Run `node .agents/skills/flow-project/references/api-client.mjs get-project --id <projectId>` to fetch project metadata (`ngNC2`, args `["tools/PINHOLE/projects/<id>"]`) and workspace state (`Zzl0ze`, args `["projects/<id>", null, null, null, [1]]`).
Run `node .agents/skills/flow-project/references/api-client.mjs get-models` to fetch live model families, variant codes, aspect ratios, durations, and credit costs (`HTrJv` and `yBhWQ`).
browser: From `flow:list-projects`, click the project link `a[href="/project/<projectId>"]`.
Poll `studio_inspect` until `url` is `/project/<projectId>` and the prompt editor (`flow-rich-text-editor`) is rendered (navigation is asynchronous).
If a changelog modal (`flow-change-log-modal`) appears, dismiss it before interacting with workspace controls.
success: API returns decoded project metadata/state, or browser reaches `/project/<projectId>` with prompt editor ready and no blocking modal.
verification: Verified both read RPCs (`ngNC2`, `Zzl0ze`, `HTrJv`, `yBhWQ`) and browser navigation on 2026-11-06.

execution.evidence: 2026-11-06: verified get-project and get-models via api-client.mjs and live browser navigation.

title: Configure image/video model and dependent options
description: Inspect or select generation mode (Image vs Video), model family, and model-dependent options (aspect ratio, output count x1-x4, resolution, duration) before submitting.

inputs.model: Image model (`Nano Banana Pro` / `GEM_PIX_2`, `Nano Banana 2 Lite` / `HARBOR_SEAL`, `Nano Banana 2.1` / `BELUGA`) or Video model (`Omni 1.1 Flash` / `abra`, `Veo 3.1 - Lite` / `veo_3_1_lite`, `Veo 3.1 - Fast` / `veo_3_1_fast`, `Veo 3.1 - Quality` / `veo_3_1_quality`).
inputs.options: Dependent parameters: Image supports aspect ratio (`16:9`, `4:3`, `1:1`, `3:4`, `9:16`) and count (`x1`..`x4`, 0 credits). Video supports sub-mode (`Frames` vs `Ingredients`), aspect ratio (`16:9` code `2`, `9:16` code `1`), resolution (`360p` vs `720p` for Omni 1.1 Flash), duration (`4s`/`6s`/`8s`/`10s` for Omni; `4s`/`6s`/`8s` for Veo 3.1), and count (`x1`..`x4`).

api: Changing settings in the UI mutates local Angular state without firing a save RPC; options are sent inside the generation RPC payload upon submission.

Use `node .agents/skills/flow-project/references/api-client.mjs get-models` (`HTrJv` / `yBhWQ`) to query the exact server-side dependency matrix (valid variant codes, supported aspect ratios, durations, max counts, and credit cost per variant) before constructing API payloads or driving UI.
browser: Inside `/project/<id>`, click the settings trigger button (`button[aria-label='Điều kiện kích hoạt cài đặt']`) in `flow-base-prompt-box`.
Select mode toggle (`imageHình ảnh` or `videocamVideo`) and re-inspect immediately because Angular Material regenerates `mat-button-toggle` IDs and dependent controls.
To change model: click `flow-prompt-box-settings button` (`Chọn nhóm mô hình`), inspect overlay menu items, click the desired model, and re-inspect dependent toggles.
Select aspect ratio, resolution/duration (if video), and count (`x1`–`x4`). Verify the credit cost label (`flow-credit-cost-label`) and prompt summary chip before closing settings with `Escape`.
success: Prompt summary bar reflects the target mode, model, aspect ratio, duration/resolution, and output count `x1`–`x4` without triggering generation.
verification: Verified live UI option dependencies and `HTrJv` model catalog on 2026-11-06.

execution.evidence: 2026-11-06: HTrJv RPC provides full model dependency catalog; UI setting toggles update client state before generation submit.

title: Generate images in a Flow project
description: Submit an image prompt with model/aspect/count options in Flow; uses browser execution because standalone `ogiZ0b` RPC is gated by reCAPTCHA Enterprise (`PUBLIC_ERROR_UNUSUAL_ACTIVITY`).

inputs.options: Optional model (`GEM_PIX_2`, `HARBOR_SEAL`, `BELUGA`), aspect ratio (`16:9`, `4:3`, `1:1`, `3:4`, `9:16`), and count (`x1`–`x4`).

api: Observed RPC: POST `/_/AiSandboxAngularFrontend/data/batchexecute?rpcids=ogiZ0b`.

Payload dependency mapping in `f.req` (`args = JSON.parse(envelope[0][0][1])`): `args[1]` is an array of generation items (length = output count `1..4`, or repeated entries per image); for each item `item = args[1][i]`: `item[3]` is random 32-bit integer seed, `item[4]` is aspect ratio enum (`1` = 1:1 square observed), `item[5]` is model code (`"GEM_PIX_2"`, `"HARBOR_SEAL"`, or `"BELUGA"`), `item[7][5]` is `projectId`, `item[7][10][0]` is the reCAPTCHA Enterprise token, and `item[8][0][0][0]` is the prompt string.

reCAPTCHA Enterprise gate: Flow loads `https://www.google.com/recaptcha/enterprise.js?trustedtypes=true&render=6LdsFiUsAAAAAIjVDZcuLhaHiDn5nnHVXVRQGeMV` and attaches a single-use browser-minted token at `args[1][i][7][10][0]` and `args[3][10][0]`. Standalone API replay without a live browser-minted token returns HTTP 200 with RPC error `7 PUBLIC_ERROR_UNUSUAL_ACTIVITY`.
Therefore, always route `generate-image` to `flow:browser-generate-image` so the browser executes `grecaptcha.enterprise.execute(...)` natively upon clicking submit.
browser: Open `/project/<projectId>` (`flow:open-project`) and configure model/aspect/count if needed (`flow:configure-generation`).
Inspect `flow-rich-text-editor` to get the `[contenteditable="true"]` selector, then call `studio_fill` with `parameter: "prompt"` and verify text insertion.
Inspect and click the submit button (`flow-generate-icon-button button`, `aria-label="Bắt đầu tạo"`) once.
Wait and poll `studio_inspect` / `studio_network` until `ogiZ0b` completes and the generated image card renders in the project grid.
success: New image card finishes rendering in `/project/<projectId>` matching the requested prompt and count, with no RPC 7 error banner.
verification: Browser generation verified (1024x1024 image created); standalone API confirmed blocked by reCAPTCHA Enterprise (`PUBLIC_ERROR_UNUSUAL_ACTIVITY`).

execution.evidence: Browser UI natively mints reCAPTCHA Enterprise token (sitekey 6LdsFiUsAAAAAIjVDZcuLhaHiDn5nnHVXVRQGeMV) and succeeds; standalone API returns RPC 7 PUBLIC_ERROR_UNUSUAL_ACTIVITY.

title: Search and filter project assets
description: Search and filter generated images, videos, scenes, and characters inside a Flow project workspace.

inputs.filters: Asset type (Image, Video, Collection, Scene, Character), aspect ratio, creation/upload/favorite state, duration (`4s`–`10s`), resolution (`720p`/`360p`), or sort order.

api: Initial project assets are returned in `Zzl0ze` (`get-project` in `api-client.mjs`). Opening the filter menu and toggling filters on an empty project updates client view state without firing a separate search RPC.
Use `getProject({ projectId })` in `api-client.mjs` to read raw project state via API, or use the browser UI filter bar.
browser: Inside `/project/<projectId>`, inspect `flow-search-bar` for the search input and filter button (`Các lựa chọn lọc và sắp xếp`).
Fill search input if `query` is provided, or click the filter button to open the filter popover.

Match checkbox/radio options by surrounding section text before clicking (Angular Material checkbox IDs `#mat-mdc-checkbox-*` are dynamic). Use the reset button (`Xoá tất cả bộ lọc`) only to clear filters.
success: Returns matching asset cards/counts and clearly reports active filters.
verification: Verified filter panel controls and `Zzl0ze` project state RPC on 2026-11-06.

execution.evidence: Project state RPC Zzl0ze and browser filter controls verified on 2026-11-06.
